non_blocking_findings.summary: The accepted evidence is an offline synthetic engineering evaluation, not investment-performance evidence.
non_blocking_findings.assessment: The canonical fixture has 2 tickers, 48 source cutoffs, 11 folds and 22 common eligible OOS forecasts per variant, so it remains PRELIMINARY. Full Model underperformance remains disclosed, no investment-success claim is made, and live provider/external trace/database validation remains intentionally outside this local Stage 09 acceptance.

resolved_findings.evidence: evaluation/point_in_time_dataset.py now forces source-dataset classification through eligible_oos_forecasts=0, so source-row volume cannot claim SCIENTIFIC. evaluation/monthly_backtest.py classifies only after all seven variants have identical fold/ticker/as_of identity and equal coverage, using the common executed OOS count. Independent checks returned 600 source rows=PRELIMINARY, 499 OOS=PRELIMINARY, 500 OOS=SCIENTIFIC, 9 tickers at 500=PRELIMINARY and 59 cutoffs at 500=PRELIMINARY.

STAGE09_RUNTIME_IDENTITY is 09/r1/a2/quant with implementation_version stage09-r1-a2, and every Stage 09 event derives from it. Independent canonical-run inspection found every emitted event had current identity, finite non-negative latency, bounded payload fields and ordered progress; a sink raising PRIVATE_SENTINEL did not change the scientific report.

Measured local lifecycle/progress/error instrumentation remains present for fixture materialization, fold model fit, fold prediction, metric aggregation, leakage audit, run and run progress. Closed allowlists, stable fail-closed codes, privacy redaction and sink-failure isolation are preserved.
